description:
[Taxonomy VI.106 — baseline response (public data only)] Classify a denial letter or remittance advice into normalized denial-reason categories.

WHEN TO USE: User or caller wants a probabilistic estimate (denial likelihood, appeal success, payment delay, etc.) to decide whether to pursue a path.

WHEN NOT: For hard facts (dollar amounts, code definitions, deadlines). Predictions carry confidence bands; call out the uncertainty when you relay the number.
name: denial_reason_classifier
